extra_primary_crosscheck: Independently fetched bminor/glibc glibc-2.39 versions of these four files through read-only GitHub; same mapping-origin formulas. This does not identify the running libc version.

findings.evidence: glibc elf/dl-addr.c:31 assigns dli_fbase from l_map_start. include/link.h:254-256 explicitly separates this from l_addr.

glibc elf/rtld.c:1129-1131 derives l_addr from actual PHDR pointer and file virtual address; lines1158-1162 set l_map_start to lowest page-rounded load virtual address plus l_addr. ET_EXEC st_value is therefore not offset from nonzero dli_fbase.
glibc elf/dl-map-segments.h:100-106 records l_addr as mapped start minus first segment mapstart; lines130-132 state the inverse relation. ET_DYN does not imply lowest virtual load page is zero.

_mapping_relation computes bias=actual evaluator anchor-record value, requires bias=0 for ET_EXEC, page alignment, image_base=bias+lowest_load_page, and same first actual file map. _live_symbols uses bias+record value rather than dli_fbase+record value.
_runtime_profile reads the current positive power-of-two SC_PAGE_SIZE and uses it for the lowest load page, distinct from segment p_align.

Unique executable file-backed symbols and actual map spans remain prerequisite before string_at; live symbols check both address endpoints via dladdr and full code bytes; final vectorcall exported pointer and runtime bytes/maps are rechecked. The full map/RELRO algorithm was not re-audited by this reviewer.

The r2 static ELF report says ET_EXEC type2, six PT_LOAD records and evaluator st_value25240320. This reviewer read that report but did not independently rehash the executable or reproduce a live map, and does not claim the report is a new runtime result.

scope: Official loader semantics, exact ET_EXEC versus ET_DYN address origins, and their r4b source binding only. No compiler, dlopen, mapped-code admission, runtime/lifetime case, or product invocation.
unchanged_history: Original r3 profile HOLD and old dli_fbase-as-bias source remain preserved. This review does not retroactively qualify them.
